The '''''RNS'' ''Queen Amidala IV''''' was a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] serving in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. The ship was a starliner converted in [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]]. It was named after former [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]'''.'''
